== Description ==

[[Mike Turner]] (left, short hair, smiling, reaching across the table to shake hands), [[Logan Pietig]] (right, brown hair, black UWL hoodie, smiling, shaking hands), and [[Steve Harpster]] (mid, white hair, glasses, black jacket, watching the handshake) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
